chunks: There is none who can take away the favours He bestows on man; and there is none apart from Him to restore what He has withheld. He is all-mighty and all-wise.

key_terms.مُرْسِلَ: one who releases or sends forth
key_terms.مُمْسِكَ: one who withholds or keeps back

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God opens or withholds mercy?
ai.summary: This verse, widely cited in Shia tafsir as a cornerstone of divine omnipotence (Qudrah), underscores that the distribution of rahmah (mercy) is exclusively a divine prerogative, independent of human agency. It serves as a theological basis for the concept of 'Tawhid al-Af'al', affirming that while God is Al-Aziz (The Almighty) in executing His will, He is also Al-Hakim (The Wise) in the precise timing and manner of bestowing or withholding blessings.
